summary: Read an n-by-n matrix of integers together with an integer k. Each row grows from left to right, and each column grows from top to bottom. Sort every integer in the matrix from small to large and take the one that lands in rank k, where k starts at 1. The rank k is always legal and stays between 1 and n squared. It is not the cell reached by scanning row after row. Write that integer.
notes: Compare after trimming trailing newlines. The input is tokens in the same order as the method parameters.
